description: Is the museum open on a given date, what are the hours, and which rooms are closed. For museums with a room-by-room route (currently the British Museum) it returns every stop of the travel.art route with its status for that date — open, closed, 'check on the day' — and the looking time that remains. Use before recommending a visit date: 'can I see the Rosetta Stone on 16 January', 'is the Louvre open on Tuesday 2 March'.

evening.description: Visiting during a late (Friday evening) opening. Default false.
